description: This file defines a PHP interface named 'CapableViewController' within the OrangeHRM core authorization controller namespace. The interface declares a method 'isCapable' that takes a Request object and returns a boolean, indicating whether the implementing class has certain capabilities.

classes.name: CapableViewController
classes.description: A PHP interface specifying that implementing classes should determine their capability based on a Request object.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Declares a method that checks if the current object is capable based on the provided Request instance.
